Name: tone
Description: Tonotopy localizer as an on/off design: each swept `tone` (~25.75 s) against the silent `fixation` remainder of its 32 s cycle (converter: src/python/raw2bids_converters/localizer_events.py; design: mmmdata-docs tasks-localizer.md, task-tone). The task is phase-encoded; its proper analysis is the response phase at 1/32 Hz, which this model does not estimate. toneVsFixation rests on a ~6 s silent gap per cycle, so it is a weak, coarse auditory-responsiveness contrast, written for the data-quality regime comparison (T1.6, 2026-09-29), where every regime sees the same weak design. The 32 s period is far above the drift terms, so drift does not absorb it (unlike task-auditory's single block). The sweep direction (`direction`) is not modelled.
